messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Malayalam, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Malayalam line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
അപ്പോൾ ഭയം അല്പം ശാന്തമായി, എന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തിന്റെ തടാകത്തിൽ അത് നിലനിന്നിരുന്നു ഞാൻ അത്യന്തം ദയയോടെ കടന്ന രാത്രി.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | Allor | temporal adverb “then” | **അപ്പോൾ** | “then” | OK | | fu | copular verb “was” (past) | — (copula omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | la (1) | definite article “the” (before *paura*) | — (article omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | paura | noun “fear” | **ഭയം** | “fear” | OK | | un | indefinite article “a” | — (article omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | poco | adverb of degree “little, a bit” | **അൽപം** | “a little” | OK | | queta* | adjective/past participle “quieted” | **ശാന്തമായി** | “quieted / became quiet” | OK | | che | relative pronoun “which” | **അത്** | “that / it” | OK | | nel | preposition “in the” | **തടാകത്തിൽ** (part of “തടാകത്തിൽ”) | “in the lake” | OK | | lago | noun “lake” | **തടാകത്തിൽ** | “lake (in …)” | OK | | del | preposition “of the” (genitive) | **ഹൃദയത്തിന്റെ** | “of the heart” | OK | | cor | noun “heart” (poetic *cor*) | **ഹൃദയം** (within **ഹൃദയത്തിന്റെ**) | “heart” | OK | | m'era | auxiliary “had been” (pluperfect) | **നിലനിന്നിരുന്നു** (part of the verb) | “had been / had lasted” | OK | | durata | past participle “lasted” | **നിലനിന്നിരുന്നു** (same verb) | “lasted” | OK | | la (2) | definite article “the” (before *notte*) | — (article omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | notte | noun “night” | **രാത്രി** | “night” | OK | | ch'i' | relative pronoun + pronoun “that I” | **ഞാൻ** | “I” (subject of the clause) | OK | | passai | verb “passed” (remote past) | **കടന്ന** | “passed / endured” | OK | | con | preposition “with” | **ദയയോടെ** (contains “with”) | “with pity” | OK | | tanta | adjective “so much” (degree) | **അത്യന്തം** | “so” / “very” | OK | | pieta* | noun “pity” | **ദയ** (within **ദയയോടെ**) | “pity” | OK |
\* Spelling in the source is archaic (*queta*, *pieta*); the modern equivalents are *quieta* and *pietà*.
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *fu*, *la* (both occurrences), *un* – Italian articles and copula are naturally omitted in Malayalam. - **MISSING / WRONG / GRAMMAR**: none.
All other source words are represented in the Malayalam rendering with appropriate meaning and grammatical fit.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Malayalam script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 19: - Original: അപ്പോൾ ഭയം **അല്പം** ശാന്തമായി, - Issue: Wrong spelling of “അല്പം” (should be “അൽപം”). - Corrected: അപ്പോൾ ഭയം **അൽപം** ശാന്തമായി, - Line 20: - Original: എന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തിന്റെ തടാകത്തിൽ അത് നിലനിന്നിരുന്നു - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 21: - Original: ഞാൻ അത്യന്തം ദയയോടെ കടന്ന രാത്രി. - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
